kind: feasibility pilot (1 problem): a frontier session's held whole proof, reduced to its lemma statements, filled by the Kaggle prover; no claim
question: given only the statements of a blueprint whose holes a frontier session is known to have proved, do Goedel-Prover-V2-8B's samples (plus Lean's recipes and the free chain) close every hole, so that the whole proof is assembled and checked by the kernel? Nothing else is read from this run
guide: claude (opencode director session 2026-11-21): the statements of its own held proof (DECISIONS 2026-11-21), propositions only

blueprint.note: gate PASS on GitHub's runner, blueprint-gate run 44956132346 (audit 5 of 5 clean, no duplicate, sketch wellformed under the default closing line)

held_proof.where: the maintainer's checkout, .lake/guided/numbertheory_exk2/Candidate.lean (untracked); exact-target Lean 4.33.1 pass on TUF 2026-11-21, judged file sha256 93a10057825fc82abf4ec7fa9cb19b93e5501fadc3a888de5ca6cb20751823f5
held_proof.why_held: posting it closes the problem and takes it out of every later free try; it stays unposted until this batch is judged
held_proof.hole_difficulty: uneven by design of the source proof: hole 2 (b + a^2 <= a + b^2 -> a = 1) carries the held proof's main argument, holes 1, 4, 5 are short; a hole the prover cannot close is the measurement, and a sub-blueprint of it is a later manifest

export: all 5 holes, each its own file with the earlier statements as hypotheses bp_1.. (blueprint.kaggle_work); 40 samples planned; holes Lean closes at judge time are sampled too and those samples count as generated and unread

generation.revision_note: no revision pinned: only hint_pairs batches load a frozen revision (tools/prover_kernel.py:90-98), and `model` stays the bare id because prover.canary_refusal compares it exactly
generation.settings: max_tokens 16000, temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, half precision, 2 x T4 (tools/prover_kernel.py at the commit that carries this manifest)
generation.prompt: the kernel's PROMPT, unchanged: the hole's file with `sorry`, then the proof-plan instruction
generation.expected: about 1.7 h of the week's free GPU hours by the 2026-11-16 rate (48 samples in 112 min); queue time unknown; $0

judging.lean: leanprover/lean4:v4.33.1, mathlib v4.33.1 (lake-manifest.json), the judge of tools/check.py
judging.order: Lean's baseline recipes on every hole first; then each sample of an open hole in sample order (a fenced `theorem sb_goal` block); a rejected proof goes through the free chain before it counts; the first accept closes the hole; with all holes closed the whole proof is judged
judging.attribution: closed_by is lean or kaggle-goedel-prover-v2-8b; a try the free chain rescued carries repaired=true and is reported as prover plus chain

credit: a solve here is guided, and its guide is a frontier model that had already proved the problem: never 'free models plus tools', and never read as the prover solving the problem alone. Rows committed; accepted TEXT held in the prover run's artifact, not in verified/ or the site
claim: none. One problem, one blueprint, 8 samples a hole: whether a small prover can fill holes of a known-good decomposition, not a rate and not tool lift
before_any_comparative_claim: REQUIRED: the same prover cold on the whole problem with the same sample budget, and more than one problem (the sister manifest pilot-guided-kaggle-held-2026-11-21b on amc12a_2008_p25 is the second)
